quotes.editorial_reason: Earnest hereditary loyalty and obedience. Repeats 122 and 136 without a self-contained reversal.

quotes.quote: "The General [Aguinaldo] has given me a Platoon of available men and has ordered me to defend [Tirad] Pass. I am aware what a difficult task has been given me. quotes.quote: "The most ghastly injuries are caused by shells: heads partially or completely torn off, open skulls showing the bare brain, shattered arms and legs, torn bodies. If a shell hits the chest or stomach and explodes there, it sometimes tears everything out, so that one can see the spine openly from the front."

quotes.editorial_reason: Potential anti-glory counterweight, but graphic injury is not itself irony. Keep at most one of 153/154 and verify the edition, page and translation.
